lines: Peaceful protests by our neighbors over in Kalinistan some months ago were met with deadly force by the state police, in a tragedy called "Tearful Tuesday".
As a result, riots broke out all over the nation, and the current ruler was dethroned.
A democratic election is to take place in the coming months, and the citizens rejoiced as their voices were heard for the first time in the nation's history.
I cannot imagine why this important event was not spread throughout the citizens of our nations, and was instead censored by the Office of Publishing.
